prompt: At first glance, a group of irregularly overlapping fluorescent hand-torn paper title blocks forms a strong visual anchor: huge, centered, staggered lines, with glyphs formed as if by thick brush strokes and paper-cutting combined, thick strokes, rough and broken edges, exaggerated corners, varied counter sizes, and slight local misalignments, making the text look like hand-printed graphics rather than neat typesetting. Build a circular, loose but clear reading path activity information system around the title, with several blue-and-white outlined hand-drawn sticker badges distributed around it; each badge is connected to a small illustration, location marker, or symbol related to the theme and a white label, varying in size and slightly in direction, as if stuck on the paper at random; the subject and label share an eye-catching blue outer contour and yellow fill, forming a unified brushstroke across elements. The background uses warm fibrous paper and old poster texture, a large area of tan base color, retaining paper grain, indentations, slight color differences, and printing bleeding edges; organize the empty space with dark brown hand-drawn dotted lines, arcs, arrows, and a small amount of English geometric lettering, but without being obtrusive. Main colors are locked to ochre brown, bright yellow, vivid blue, cream white, using flat coating and limited overlapping colors, without using modern gradients, glass textures, or over-smooth digital shadows. All graphics, text, stickers, and background share slightly unstable manual outlines, overprinting offsets, thickness variations, and local wear, retaining imperfect production traces; clear information hierarchy, central title heaviest, surrounding modules forming rhythm and breathing, the whole piece is like an urban cultural activity poster completed by clipping, hand-drawing, screen printing, and old paper.
